subject: reactive plots not appearing in shiny app

messages.author: f1fb35f41a65fbc7
messages.subject: reactive plots not appearing in shiny app
parts:
Hi all, I have also posted this problem on StackOverflow as well here.

I am having trouble using a reactive function. I am building an inventory dashboard for my store. We have 3 different departments the want to view their inventory on their own tab.

Initially, the radio button for "top" was set as a constant to show the top 20 items by their sales volume. The dashboard was working great as is. However, my departments would like to be able to use a numeric input and show the top X products. So I attempting to use a reactive function and numeric input. I am basically filtering the dataframe by calling: 

   
filterCapPlot <- reactive({ db.table.caplab.top20 <- head(arrange(db.table.caplab, desc(QtyDispensedMA)), n = input$ui.top) })

When I run the app I get no errors, and the buttons and table appear, but the chart area is completely white.


I will post a more condensed version of the code than what is on SO.

library(shiny) library(shinythemes) library(RODBC) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) library(ggthemes) library(lubridate) ui<-fluidPage( tags$style(type="text/css", ".recalculating {opacity: 1.0;}" ), theme = shinytheme("superhero"), titlePanel("Inventory Dashboard"), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel(HTML("<font size='3' color='firebrick'>Select which view you would like to see</font>"), width = 2, radioButtons("ui.show", label = "Show Me:", choices = list("Top ___" = "Top", "Only Negative" = "Only Negative", "Only Below Reorder Point" = "Only Below Reorder" )), numericInput("ui.top", "Show Top ___ Compounds: ", 20), checkboxInput("ui.parlevel", label = "Par Level", value = TRUE) ), mainPanel( tabsetPanel( tabPanel("Cap Lab", plotOutput("capPlot"), dataTableOutput("capTable")), tabPanel("Wet Lab", plotOutput("wetPlot"), dataTableOutput("wetTable")), tabPanel("IV Lab", plotOutput("ivPlot"), dataTableOutput("ivTable")) ) ) ) ) server <- function(input, output) { # DATA FRAMES { #inital SQL and setting table to only items that are inventoried db.rxq <- odbcDriverConnect('driver={SQL Server};server=server;database=database;uid=UN;pwd=PW') db.table <- as.data.frame(sqlQuery(db.rxq, 'SELECT * FROM Drug INNER JOIN DrugInventory ON Drug.KeyFld = DrugInventory.DrugInventoryKey')) db.table.inventoried <- filter(db.table, IsValid.1 == 1) db.table.inventoried$LastDateDispensed <- parse_date_time(db.table.inventoried$LastDateDispensed, orders = "mdy") db.table.inventoried$LastDateDispensed <- format(db.table.inventoried$LastDateDispensed, "%m-%d-%Y") # CAP LAB db.table.caplab <- filter(db.table.inventoried, CustomField1 == 'Cap Lab') db.table.caplab <- db.table.caplab[ , c("Name", "Strength", "NdcNumber", "QtyInStock", "ReorderPoint", "LastDateDispensed", "QtyDispensedThisMonth", "QtyDispensedLastMonth", "QtyDispensedThisYear", "ReorderPoint", "MetricName")] db.table.caplab <- mutate(db.table.caplab, QtyDispensedMA = QtyDispensedLastMonth + QtyDispensedThisMonth, ParLevel = (QtyDispensedLastMonth / 26) * 6) db.table.caplab$ParLevel <- ceiling(db.table.caplab$ParLevel) filterCapPlot <- reactive({ db.table.caplab.top20 <- head(arrange(db.table.caplab, desc(QtyDispensedMA)), n = input$ui.top) }) } # **PLOTS & TABLES** { myTheme1 <- theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'lightgrey', color = 'lightgrey'), panel.grid.major = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey"), legend.position = "none") # CAP PLOT & TABLE { output$capPlot <- renderPlot({ if(input$ui.show == "top" && input$ui.parlevel == TRUE){ myplot.p <- ggplot(filterCapPlot(), aes(y = QtyInStock, x = reorder(Name, -QtyInStock), color = QtyInStock > 0, fill = QtyInStock > 0)) nudgeMax <- max(pmax(db.table.caplab.top20$QtyInStock, db.table.caplab.top20$ParLevel)) myplot.p + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + coord_flip() + labs(y = "Qty in Stock", x = "Drug", title = "Capsule Inventory") + scale_color_manual(guide = FALSE, values = setNames(c('black','black'),c(T, F))) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "lightblue", "FALSE" = "firebrick")) + geom_errorbar(aes(y = ParLevel, x = Name, ymin = QtyInStock, ymax = ParLevel), color="darkred", width=0.5) + geom_text(aes(x = Name, y = nudgeMax + 100, label = QtyInStock)) + myTheme1 } else if(input$ui.show == "top" && input$ui.parlevel == FALSE){ myplot.p <- ggplot(filterCapPlot(), aes(y = db.table.caplab.top20$QtyInStock, x = reorder(db.table.caplab.top20$Name, -QtyInStock), color = db.table.caplab.top20$QtyInStock > 0, fill = QtyInStock > 0)) nudgeMax <- max(pmax(db.table.caplab.top20$QtyInStock, db.table.caplab.top20$ParLevel)) myplot.p + geom_bar(stat = 'identity') + coord_flip() + labs(y = "Qty in Stock", x = "Drug", title = "Capsule Inventory") + scale_color_manual(guide = FALSE, values = setNames(c('black','black'),c(T, F))) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "lightblue", "FALSE" = "firebrick")) + geom_text(aes(x = Name, y = nudgeMax + 100, label = QtyInStock)) + myTheme1 }
})

I have been using R and shiny for only a few months now and this is my first time attempting to use reactivity. All help is appreciated!
